Page 240 Cont.
Oct. 15 Simone Dube - 19 - disappeared seven weeks ago. No trace of her as yet been received.
16 Mick Makowski - 42 - lung trouble - in Kiefer's .. .. Frank Stuger - 77 - in Iowa "dying" ..... Mrs. Marie Schreier - 54 - throat cancer - operation 3 weeks ago. ....
Page 24 1
Oct. 21 E'd Gaskin -20 - Brain tuomer - Harper Hosp. Madeline Lavell - 34 - lung ...
21 Jane Donnelly - 17 - a twin - Expected to graduate this year in high school uremic poison .... Enrolled To-day 1.00
22 John Wipp - 31 - creeping paralysis 6 yrs. - unable to work since 3 yrs. Enrolled To-day 5.00
Bernard and Margaret Kummer - parents of Two small children - not con- tented - one (she) "convert" - apparently forgetting to appreciate - the Catholic Grandma anxious .....
Mrs. Anna Popp - 63 - Stomach cancer - has husband and ten living child- ren anxiously hoping for her recovery.
Michael Crowe - 13 - Enlarged heart
Rita Faubert - 21 - T.B. in London San. over a year. Drs. fear colapse of lung, necessary - probably removal. Enrolled.
25 Lawrence DeGault - 26 - pray'd for Oct. 14 - nerve - break - Went to Dr. 22nd and pronounced Okay.
Page 242 Oct. 29th Albert Strzyzewski - 58 - in Receiving Hospital - both legs broken and hip-bone, ribs, etc. - probable fractured skull. .... accident Oct. 22nd.
Francis Horton - 40 - Throat & face Cancer - Studied for holy Priest- hood before last world war ..... went to war .... lost vocation .... no hope in science.
